execution_method: Each notebook runs in its own fresh Python process and initially empty working directory, using IPython InteractiveShell and matplotlib_inline.backend_inline. Every original code cell is executed in order, with exceptions and figures captured.
environment_limitation: Jupyter TCP and IPC kernels cannot bind sockets in this execution environment; JupyterLab browser UI and a Colab hosted runtime were not exercised.
notes: Runtime timing values are machine dependent.
The environment.yml and requirements.txt provide the scientific package versions actually exercised; JupyterLab and ipykernel ranges are interface dependencies.
The original notebooks and their existing outputs are preserved when execution finds no error.
